name: Out-of-Core View-Dependent Refinement
definition: A run-time component of an out-of-core renderer that pages in only active nodes of a level-of-detail hierarchy using memory mapping, allowing asynchronous refinement and rendering.
summary: Out-of-core view-dependent refinement dynamically constructs a view-dependent working set from a static on-disk octree using memory mapping to hide I/O latency.
